About: Support surfaces besides the desk, entered by hand: a platform or box top open above, or a shelf board with another board above it. Display frame (the AI's), cm: +X the arm's left, +Y away from the robot, +Z up; the desk is Z -2.3 (WorkspaceFrame.json TableZCm), so a box 15 cm tall on the desk has TopZCm 12.7. The bridge (object_locator, DeclaredSurfaces.py) measures objects on a surface only inside one declared here, and the web app (lib/DeclaredSurfaces.ts) holds a task's tip and gripper above the surface its object stands on. Frame: cart (the cart parked; the only one today). Copy Example into Surfaces and edit it; Enabled false keeps an entry without using it.
